voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Flannan Isles, Scotland, nineteen hundred. Everyone knows the lighthouse's last log entries. A great storm. A keeper weeping. Then: God is over all.
None of those words are in the official record. A nineteen sixty-five book printed them, credited to a magazine story from nineteen twenty-nine.
The historian Mike Dash concluded that story was fiction.
The official report says the log ends on the thirteenth. A chalk slate runs to the fifteenth: the lamp cleaned, the oil filled.
The entries were invented. The disappearance was not. The three keepers were never found.
